headline: Discussed a sober living home complaint at 13 Albion Street, brochure translation, and upcoming events; no votes recorded.
summary: Members discussed a complaint about the sober living home at 13 Albion Street, and Maria was tasked to follow up. They also reviewed printed brochures, the fair housing plan, and upcoming events such as Juneteenth, Malden Pride, and National Night Out. The minutes record no votes or formal decisions.

Meeting notes
Sober Living Home Complaint Discussion: Paul, Maria, and Taylor discussed a new complaint regarding 
the sober living home at 13 Albion Street, focusing on issues faced by occupants, potential closure, and 
the need to clarify ownership and organizational responsibility, with Maria tasked to follow up and 
gather more information.06:33
Brochure Printing and Distribution Updates: Maria and Paul reviewed the status of printed brochures 
for commission events, confirming that 250 copies were produced by Minuteman and discussing plans 
for translation and further distribution.
Event Participation and Planning: Elaine, Maria, and Paul discussed recent and upcoming events, 
including Juneteenth, Malden Pride, and National Night Out, covering tabling experiences, outreach 
efforts, and logistical considerations such as shade and tent usage.

Fair Housing Plan Progress: Maria and Paul discussed the status of the fair housing plan, noting that the 
Office of Strategic Planning and Community Development is working on a fact sheet and resource 
compilation, with Maria tasked to review available materials and suggest ways to highlight them.
Adaptive Birding Tour Event Announcement: Maria and Chukwuka invited the group to a free adaptive
birding tour event at Linden Square on July 11th, highlighting collaboration with local organizations and 
accessibility provisions for the disability community.
AI-Assisted Meeting Minutes Discussion: Chukwuka and Malden discussed the use of AI tools like 
ChatGPT for recording and summarizing meeting minutes, with Malden describing their process for 
reviewing and formatting AI-generated content for official records.
Follow-up tasks
Sober Living Home Complaint Follow-Up: Continue reviewing the complaint materials for 13 Albion 
Street, determine relevant departments to contact, and follow up with the complainant to clarify the 
situation and potential fair housing issues. (Maria)
Brochure Translation: Arrange for the translation of the printed Human Rights and Fair Housing 
Commission brochures. (Maria)
National Night Out Tabling Logistics: Confirm whether a tent can be used for tabling at National Night 
Out and clarify the location of tables (walkway vs. field). (Maria)
Fair Housing Plan Resource Review: Check the Office of Strategic Planning and Community 
Development’s webpage for existing fair housing resources and identify items to highlight or create a 
fact sheet. (Maria)
Meeting Adjourned at 6:25 PM
